defect: A streaming cancellation signal seen once was lost by the final callback poll, causing an I/O error classification and removal of a valid cache entry on restore.
fix: Latch the first observed cancellation for each write_stream/read_stream operation and stop polling its callback after cancellation.

before.failure: Expected SwapError::Cancelled; assertion failed before production change.

coverage: Single-signal write and read cancellation with propagating and swallowing codecs.
Failed write disk reservation releases fully.
Cancelled read preserves immutable disk handle and retry succeeds.
ImageSwapCache cancellation after restored allocation releases pixels, does not increment errors, retains entry for a successful retry.
limitations: This does not make quota-driven eviction before an incoming swap write transactional.
Cancellation is observed at stream I/O checkpoints; arbitrary codec computation is not preempted.
